entries.headline: Six transports and elevated Eastern Mediterranean air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US military transport aircraft airborne across the Atlantic and North America. It described Eastern Mediterranean air activity as nearly three times normal and mentioned a US bomber withdrawal, without identifying a comparison period or providing full withdrawal details.

entries.headline: Six heavy transports over US; bomber withdrawal from England reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force heavy transport aircraft airborne over the United States. Separately, it relayed a claim that US bombers were withdrawn from England after intelligence about an Iran-backed plot; the visible post did not provide the plot's details or a withdrawal date.

entries.headline: RIZZY67 RC-135S Cobra Ball sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a Boeing RC-135S Cobra Ball sighting credited to reagan0965, with callsign RIZZY67, aircraft hex AE01D6 and registration 61-2663. The post did not specify its location or mission.

entries.headline: SAM103 C-37B sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a Gulfstream C-37B sighting credited to reagan0965, identifying callsign SAM103, aircraft hex AE206D and the US Air Force's 89th Airlift Wing at Andrews Air Force Base. The post did not specify the aircraft's observed location or mission.

entries.headline: Six transports over US and one recent coded broadcast reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and one coded US Air Force radio broadcast heard in the preceding hour. It described the activity level as routine without giving message content or specific flight missions.

entries.headline: E-6 Mercury sighting with aircraft hex AE9F86
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a Boeing E-6 Mercury sighting credited to reagan0965, identifying aircraft hex AE9F86 and no callsign. The visible post did not specify a location or mission.

entries.headline: War Watch relays report of B-1 withdrawal from England
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a report credited to @reagan0965 that the United States had rushed to withdraw 12 B-1 bombers from a base in southern England after commanders received new intelligence. The visible text was incomplete and did not identify the intelligence, base or withdrawal date.

entries.headline: Six transports and multiple recent coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne and multiple coded military radio broadcasts heard in the preceding hour. The post did not identify the aircraft locations, missions or message content.

entries.headline: Transports across Atlantic and North America; Russian jet over Massachusetts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne across the Atlantic and North America and a Russian government jet over Massachusetts. It mentioned Coast Guard search-and-rescue activity but did not establish a connection to the Russian aircraft.

entries.headline: Six US cargo and command aircraft; Russian transport and drone attacks reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US military cargo and command aircraft airborne over the continental United States and a Russian government transport aircraft nearby. It also described Ukrainian drone attacks into Russia as intensifying, without identifying specific targets or linking the aircraft sightings to the attacks.

entries.headline: Six transports over US and Russian government jet near US airspace reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and a Russian government jet near US airspace. It described continuing radio activity as routine without identifying the flights' missions or radio-message content.

entries.headline: War Watch relays air-ambulance search off Nantucket
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a report credited to @charlottewilliams922 that the US Coast Guard was conducting a search and rescue for a Gulfstream G100 air ambulance off Nantucket, Massachusetts. The visible post did not provide an outcome or details about those aboard.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: ASY169 P-8 landing alert at Misawa
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for ASY169, described as an Australian-registered military P-8, at Misawa, Japan. The post reported a recent landing without confirming a specific mission.

entries.headline: PDN01 P-8 ground alert at Marton
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for PDN01, described as a New Zealand-registered military P-8, at Marton, New Zealand. The post reported ground status without confirming a specific mission.

entries.headline: E-6 airborne alert at Hickam Field
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US military E-6 TACAMO aircraft at Hickam Field, Hawaii. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm a destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: BFLO21 P-8 landing alert near Darwin
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for BFLO21, described as an Australian military P-8 Poseidon, near Darwin, Australia. The post described a landing without confirming a specific mission.

entries.headline: PDN04 P-8 ground alert at Marton

entries.headline: P-8 alert near Grand Falls
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a US military P-8 Poseidon near Grand Falls, with the location code CA and no callsign. The accompanying text described the aircraft as at ground, so the post's ground-status descriptions were inconsistent; no specific mission was confirmed.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert near Karambakkudi
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for an Indian military P-8 near Karambakkudi, India. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm the aircraft's destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares Navy F-35 mission-planning redesign report
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that the US Navy was seeking help to redesign F-35 mission-planning software used for sortie preparation and tactical data loading. The post described a proposed redesign without confirming a completed upgrade.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares Taiwan F-16C Block 70 delivery report
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared an Aviationist report that Taiwan had received its first two new-build F-16C Block 70 fighters after delays. The post relayed the report without providing independent confirmation or a delivery date.
